_comment: Reviewer labels for the synthetic fixtures: what a human reviewer would decide for each case. Ground truth for evaluation, kept separate from the cases themselves because in a real deployment labels come from reviewers long after the case arrives.

name_order_swapped.note: given and family name ordered differently on the form

middle_name_missing.note: middle name omitted on the form

dob_day_month_transposed.note: date fields disagree; a person should confirm which is correct

document_number_ocr_confusion.note: zero read as the letter O

second_person_in_frame.note: a second face appears partway through the recording

different_person_in_video.note: the person recorded is not the person on the document

data_only_clean.note: documents agree; provider supplies no video
